subject: CPPO: legacy account consolidation & entitlement reconciliation
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@cloudresell.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Cc: aws-ppo@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO coordination — legacy account consolidation

Hi Vanessa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran two quick audits on our side and found overlapping buyer entities that are currently mapped to separate Marketplace SKUs. The consolidated account model that our finance team needs would change how entitlements are provisioned (some subscriptions would need to be split across two legal entities).

High-level ask: can Redwood help us reconcile the entitlements so we (1) preserve committed spend for the seller PO, (2) ensure invoice routing aligns with our internal payor mapping, and (3) get a small pool of demo credits to surface the consolidated offering to our partners?

I've attached an entity_map (CloudResell-entity-map.xlsx) showing current vs proposed mappings and highlighted three edge-case subscriptions that require manual entitlement edits. Also copying the AWS PPPO alias since they will need to sign the private-offer ACL once changes are confirmed.

Ideal timeline: we want a proposed reconciliation by EOD Wed (9 Jun) to keep our renewal window.

Can you confirm next steps and whether you need a call with our billing lead?

Thanks,
Elena Soto
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
CloudResell Inc.

Attachment: CloudResell-entity-map.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
Cc: elena@cloudresell.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO coordination — legacy account consolidation

Thanks Elena — received and looked through the attachment. High level thoughts for internal ops before we loop back to CloudResell: 

- Quick triage: three subscriptions flagged are cross-entity SKUs where entitlements won't automatically split. We'll need a manual entitlement reissue for two of them and a new split invoice mapping for the third.
- Risk: if we change entitlement anchor on the PPPO without an explicit purchase amendment it may create billing mismatches. Recommend we keep the existing PPPO SKU but create new entitlement records under the consolidated buyer for forward invoices; preserve historical invoices as-is.
- Credits: we can offer a 5k USD demo credit pool scoped to the consolidated account. That requires legal approval for promotional credits — Ben can own that path.

Next steps I propose (internal):
1) Ben: confirm promotional credit approval + funding source (marketing vs sales dev).
2) Aditya: draft the entitlement reconciliation plan (step-by-step edits, which SKUs to touch, fallback if DocuSign not executed). Use the attached template RDW-proposed-entitlement-split.pdf.
3) Jordan: prepare a short runbook for our support engineers to perform the two manual entitlement edits during a low-traffic window.

If we can turn around the plan by Wed morning, I will share it with Elena and request a short call with their billing lead to align on invoice routing.

- Vanessa
Director, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
From: vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Elena Soto <elena@cloudresell.com>, ben.carter@redwoodinference.com, aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com, jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 08:52:00 -0700
Subject: RE: CPPO coordination — legacy account consolidation (proposed plan attached)

Elena — attached is our proposed reconciliation plan and a suggested DocuSign ACL flow so the private-offer entitlements map correctly after the split. TL;DR:
- Manual entitlement edits: 2 subscriptions — schedule: Thu 10 Jun 02:00-03:00 PT (low traffic).
- Invoice mapping: create a split payor mapping for subscription #C-324 per your spreadsheet; historical invoices remain on legacy payor.
- Promo credits: 5k USD one-time credit applied as usage offset over 90 days (requires Ben to confirm internal funding).

Attachments: RDW-proposed-entitlement-split.pdf (PDF, 28KB)
DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign?envelopeId=abc123-docsign

Requesting: Elena, please confirm that the mapped payor entity details in tab "Proposed" are correct and that your billing lead (cc if possible) is available for a 20-minute sync today. If the DocuSign flow is approved we will not proceed with edits until the envelope is fully executed.

Ben: can you confirm funding for the demo credits by EOD today so we can include the credit terms in DocuSign?
Aditya / Jordan: stand by for support runbook and entitlement edit checklist in the next hour.

Thanks all,
- Vanessa
